title: Inbox surfacing and aging nudges on the global dashboard
description: WHY: an inbox nobody sees is a junk drawer with extra steps; the board needs an Inbox rail and the directive system should nudge when items age. WHAT: (1) add inbox summary (count, oldest item age) to the global dashboard payload and render an Inbox rail in both CLI dashboard and console views; (2) emit an advisory enforcement gap (new code such as inbox.triage.aging) from the global workspace when items exceed an age threshold, projected through the standard registry mechanism into an advisory directive naming the triage command - severity advisory, never required, since untriaged notes are debt not violation; (3) threshold configurable in the global workspace policy with a sane default around seven days.
acceptanceCriteria: Global dashboard shows inbox count and oldest-item age
Items older than the threshold produce an advisory directive naming the triage command, covered by a fixture test
closedReason: Acceptance criteria met; pnpm check passed; closeout summary bw_summary_ff1fd0a830667a1e recorded; commit b73c9616.
